description: August 18 birthday meaning: Leo decan 3, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an August 18 birthday falls in Leo, in the third decan, with Sun as the sign's ruler and Mars as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Leo is fixed and fire.

sections.heading: The August 18 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: On August 18th, the courage of Mars meets the compassion of 9, twenty-five degrees into Leo. This blend is often read as a crusader's birthday: someone who fights for others, speaks up for the overlooked and puts energy behind causes. Interpretive traditions advise picking battles carefully, because this birthday tends to feel every injustice personally.

Astronomically, August 18 puts the Sun near 25° Leo in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Mars. The final third of Leo sits under Mars, ruler of Aries, and so mid-to-late August birthdays tend to carry the most forceful version of the sign. Courage, competitiveness and a readiness to defend people or principles are commonly associated with this decan. These Leos often lead from the front and prefer action to ceremony. Mars can make the temper quick and the pride prickly, especially when they feel challenged in public. The same fire gives them stamina for long campaigns. Channelling it into a cause bigger than personal recognition is often where this decan does its most memorable work.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for August 18
paragraphs: A birthday on the 18th reduces as 1 + 8 = 9, so the birthday number is 9. The compound pairs the 1's leadership with the 8's capacity to organise and manage, then turns both towards the 9's humanitarian outlook. Eighteenth-born people are often described as able to make a real difference: they can organise a fundraiser, run a team or argue a cause convincingly. Emotional openness may sometimes lag behind their practical help. This secondary number tends to suit those who use their influence for others rather than for status, and who measure success by what it changes.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an August 18 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 2 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous August 18 birthdays
paragraphs: An August birthday falls in late northern summer, a season of early harvests and holidays, and in late winter for the southern hemisphere, when the first blossom starts to appear. Leo holds most of the month, with Virgo arriving around August 22 or 23. August is month 8 in numerology, associated with ambition, authority and material skill, a fitting partner for Leo's confidence. August 18 is the 230th day of the year (231st in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Virgo, is usually complete within 5 days, by August 23.

By August 18 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an August 18 birthday are Roman Polanski (1933), Franz Joseph I of Austria (1830) and Robert Redford (1936).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is August 18?
faq.answer: August 18 is Leo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Leo, which tradition links with Mars.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on August 18?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On August 18 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 2 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 18th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on August 18?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by August 18, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on August 18?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on August 18 include Roman Polanski (1933), Franz Joseph I of Austria (1830) and Robert Redford (1936). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
